definitions.explanation: Being so shocked or surprised that one is unable to speak or react.

examples.japanese: その{知|し}らせに{唖然|あぜん}とした。
examples.english: I was stunned by the news.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{発言|はつげん}に{一同|いちどう}{唖然|あぜん}となった。
examples.english: Everyone was left speechless by his remark.

examples.japanese: {予想|よそう}{外|がい}の{展開|てんかい}に{唖然|あぜん}として{言葉|ことば}も{出|で}なかった。
examples.english: I was so dumbfounded by the unexpected turn of events that I couldn't find any words.

notes:
{唖然|あぜん} describes being rendered speechless by surprise or shock. The character {唖|あ} relates to being mute/unable to speak.

Common patterns:
- {唖然|あぜん}とする: to be dumbfounded
- {唖然|あぜん}となる: to become speechless
- {唖然|あぜん}として: being dumbfounded (adverbial)

Related terms:
- {茫然|ぼうぜん}: dazed, stunned
- {呆然|ぼうぜん}: blank, dazed
- {愕然|がくぜん}: astonished, aghast
